title: Pareto-Optimal RTL Code Generation via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning with Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.26904v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent studies have proposed reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) methods that enable LLMs to generate high-quality RTL circuits from natural-language specifications. Existing approaches optimize circuit PPA (Power, Performance, Area) by aggregating multiple objectives into a single scalar reward, making it difficult to simultaneously generate diverse Pareto-optimal solutions across different trade-offs such as low power, low latency, and small area. However, in practical design, the relative importance of each objective varies depending on product requirements and design constraints; thus, obtaining a diverse and high-quality candidate set is beneficial in that designers can choose a preferred trade-off a posteriori. translated_title: 基于大语言模型多目标强化学习的帕累托最优RTL代码生成
translated_abstract: 近期研究提出了可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）方法，使大语言模型能够根据自然语言规范生成高质量的RTL电路。现有方法通过将多个目标聚合为单一标量奖励来优化电路的PPA（功耗、性能、面积），这使得难以同时生成覆盖低功耗、低延迟和小面积等不同权衡方向的多样化帕累托最优解。然而，在实际设计中，各目标的相对重要性会随产品需求和设计约束的不同而变化；因此，获得一个多样化且高质量的候选集合是有益的，设计者可以事后（a posteriori）从中选择自己偏好的权衡方案。在本工作中，我们首次提出了一种面向基于大语言模型的电路生成的学习方法，该方法优化的不是单个电路的质量，而是所获得的整个电路集合的质量与多样性……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次提出一种多目标强化学习方法，使大语言模型生成的RTL电路集合整体上兼具质量与帕累托多样性，让设计者可以事后从低功耗、低延迟、小面积等多种权衡方案中挑选最优电路。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to propose a multi-objective reinforcement learning method that optimizes the quality and diversity of the entire set of LLM-generated RTL circuits, enabling designers to a posteriori select their preferred trade-off among power, latency, and area from Pareto-optimal candidates.
